fields.value: Stop placing work on a session after finish is requested

Found while landing Task 8ffc3e (PR #85). tick sends finish to an idle rented session and then waits for ended. Until ended arrives, the session still counts as live and idle (\_idle_sessions/\_open_sessions), so a later launch can place work on it. The worker checks finish before it picks up added work, so that work never runs. Seen once as a flake in merge-group run 42317106116 (test_inputs_reach_the_job_by_name_once_and_wrong_bytes_are_refused got create_unconfirmed instead of input_undelivered). Outcome: record in the database that finish was requested and exclude that session from placement, with a behaviour test.
